name: Directional Parallel Thinning
definition: A parallel thinning algorithm that processes border voxels in specific directions (sub-cycles) to skeletonize a 3D volume. It suffers from 'annihilation' of voxels (deleting all N-type border voxels in one sub-cycle) and sensitivity to processing order, leading to boundary noise.
summary: Directional Parallel Thinning is a parallel thinning algorithm that processes boundary voxels in six specific spatial directions across sub-iterations to skeletonize 3D volumes while preventing connectivity loss and annihilation.
